scope_note: Public-source review for Apple's Washoe County data-center campus at 21505 Reno Technology Parkway West and its 2024 expansion application. A Nevada GOED biennial report supplies original-project audit findings; the later board packet supplies company-reported campus context and forecasts. Audit findings, 2024 reported conditions, and expansion projections remain separate. No campus total is allocated to the selected mapped building. The four-building campus, downtown Reno warehouse, renewable-energy projects, and more-than-200-person support statement are not collapsed into one footprint. No Switch Citadel or Storey County amount enters this evidence fragment. Actual annual construction spending, vendor payments, worker residence, taxes received by jurisdiction, realized 2024 abatement, same-scope public-service cost, facility electricity use, water use, wastewater, and quantified community transfers remain unobserved.

sources.notes: The fiscal-year 2012 two-year and five-year audit table places Apple's June 30, 2012 effective contract in Washoe County. It reports original projections of 35 jobs, a $25.00 average wage, and $400 million capital expenditure, then reports audit findings of 83 jobs, a $38.42 average wage, and $689,829,656 capital expenditure. The table marks both the June 30, 2014 two-year audit and June 30, 2017 five-year audit compliant. The reported capital total is broad and is not treated as construction-only spending, a tax receipt, or an amount attributable to one campus building.

project_updates.title: Original incentive audit findings remain campus-level
project_updates.notes: GOED's fiscal-year 2012 audit table reports 83 jobs, a $38.42 average wage, and $689,829,656 of capital expenditure for Apple after compliant two- and five-year audits. The table does not allocate the findings among buildings, separate construction from equipment, or report realized tax receipts or public-service costs.

project_updates.title: Expansion application separates construction, equipment, and estimated tax effects
project_updates.notes: The public packet separately schedules $163 million of construction cost, $742,071,428 of first-five-year equipment purchases, a $992,071,428 ten-year equipment basis for the tax analysis, and a $62,153,275 estimated tax reduction. These are forecasts in an application packet, not realized spending, benefits, tax receipts, or costs.

project_updates.title: Campus and building scopes cannot be collapsed
project_updates.notes: Apple describes four data-center buildings, a campus substation across 1,700 acres, and a downtown Reno warehouse, with more than 200 individuals supporting daily operations across those sites. Neither that statement nor the incentive schedules allocate a value to the selected mapped building.

project_updates.title: Direct-evidence search leaves realized fiscal, supplier, resource-use, and community gaps
project_updates.notes: Reviewed public Nevada GOED application and audit material, official Apple environmental/campus material, Washoe County parcel and meeting search results, and Nevada utility/regulatory search results. The review did not verify 2024 abatement realization, annual recipient-level tax receipts, same-period marginal public-service cost, vendor payments, worker residence, facility electricity or water consumption, wastewater, or quantified campus-attributable community transfers. No value is manufactured and no record request or private solicitation was sent.
